title: Over-temperature fault (controller TC07, closed loop)
purpose: Active warming of a patient stand-in from 35 degC; a test ramp on CH2 sensor A first isolates CH2 (205 sensor disagreement), then crosses 41 degC: SAFETY_SHUTDOWN (206) in the same second, RESET blocked at 1050 s while still hot, latch held after cooling, RESET at 1250 s releases, warming resumes.
data_source: Controller: Suchita's supervisory controller test TC07 (SIMULATED test bench, controller/neram_ctrl). Twin fields: test-bench stand-in values the controller received (SIMULATED).
loop_description: Closed loop with the ASSUMED patient plant and the twin stand-in.
limitations: The CH2 sensor-A ramp is an injected test stimulus, not a heater response.
T_plant is an ASSUMED plant response (k_heat 0.6 degC/h at 100 %), not a prediction.

Controller: Suchita's supervisory controller design (v2 specification); Python fallback code rebuilt by Sai on 18 Oct 2026 from that specification (reproduces her v2 logs byte for byte). Not a Simulink/Stateflow model.

Twin fields are test-bench stand-ins (synthetic inputs or a first-order filter stand-in), NOT the NERAM twin. The forecast is the stand-in's flat persistence (T_pred = T_est) with normal bands from T_est_sd.
Hardware signals and module temperatures come from test stand-ins; no hardware exists. Thresholds are placeholders (Shreehan, TBD).
No clinical, hardware or treatment claim is made.
